packaging.metadataSource: SwitchAI app/assets/claude-memory-component.json (read-only provenance snapshot; not a build dependency)
changes: Verify the complete pinned archive and every original manifest member, including the omitted host launcher, before selecting bytes.
Preserve selected runtime bytes and the original UPSTREAM.json exactly as RUNTIME-UPSTREAM.json.
Omit bin/claude-mem.exe, the previous host launcher. Preserve plugin assets as runtime source; copying them does not enable native Hooks or prove client compatibility.
Package the separate Vault adapter and identical Claude/Codex vault-memory Skill snapshots; do not import SwitchAI source or migrate existing memory data.
Require repository-relative contained Skill source paths; reject linked source paths and obvious private/user data filenames.

Require supplemental NOTICE, THIRD-PARTY.md, source references and all component-local license texts; verify NOTICE against the pinned upstream SHA256 before packaging. This is an attribution presence/integrity guard, not legal clearance.
Reject common backups of private filenames, Windows device/invalid member names, and component sources in reserved bin/, plugin/ or skill/ namespaces.
Hash and copy runtime streams in bounded chunks; stage output beside its destination before replacing files.
Guard all recorded release identity and dependency fields; changed payload bytes at an existing version require a component version bump.

vaultComponentSourceLicense.scope: Vault-authored builder, lifecycle adapters and both mirrored vault-memory Skill files use this component-level license; no per-Skill LICENSE file is required. Upstream runtime and vendored code retain their own licenses.
